summary: ZenaTech, Inc. filed a Form 6-K covering an Information Circular for its Annual and Special Meeting and a Form of Proxy. The filing incorporates by reference into its existing F-3 registration statement. This is a routine meeting notice and proxy solicitation; it does not disclose a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or management change. As a result, it falls outside the defined special-situations categories.
